title: Quantum-Inspired Risk Portfolio Optimization via Exponential Tilting
abstract: arXiv:2611.27990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial portfolio optimization is often framed through mean-variance objectives, yet real profit-and-loss (P&L) scenario distributions are typically discrete and non-Gaussian. To explore realistic P&L distributions, we propose an objective function based on exponential tilting and certainty equivalent under constant absolute risk aversion. We then derive a second-order approximation, recovering a quadratic optimization problem solvable through mixed integer quadratic programming (MIQP) and quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO). Constraints in the QUBO formulation are incorporated via Lagrangian relaxation and slack variable approaches, enabling a direct comparison between classical constrained MIQP and quantum-inspired methods. translated_title: 基于指数倾斜的量子启发风险投资组合优化
translated_abstract: 金融投资组合优化通常以均值-方差目标为框架，然而实际的损益（P&L）情景分布通常是离散且非高斯的。为了探索现实的损益分布，我们提出了一种基于指数倾斜和恒定绝对风险厌恶（CARA）下确定性等价的目标函数。随后我们推导了其二阶近似，从而恢复出一个可通过混合整数二次规划（MIQP）和二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）求解的二次优化问题。QUBO公式中的约束通过拉格朗日松弛和松弛变量方法加以纳入，使得经典约束MIQP方法与量子启发方法之间能够进行直接比较。为了研究指数倾斜如何影响均值、标准差以及诸如风险价值（VaR）和条件风险价值（CVaR）等尾部风险度量，我们设计了一个基于情景数据的实验协议。
tldr: 该论文提出基于指数倾斜与CARA确定性等价的组合优化新目标函数，通过二阶近似将其转化为可用MIQP和QUBO求解的二次优化问题，从而实现经典方法与量子启发方法的直接比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel portfolio optimization objective based on exponential tilting and CARA certainty equivalent, which through a second-order approximation reduces to a quadratic problem solvable by both MIQP and QUBO, enabling direct comparison between classical constrained and quantum-inspired methods.
